**Discpress 1.3.3: two ways to run it.** Download it as one HTML file that works anywhere, even without internet, or **use it online at [powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)** with nothing to download. The online version is also the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad. It's the same app, and in both cases your files stay on your device.

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.3.3/discpress.html)** (about 2.9 MB): the whole app in one file you keep. Best for computers and Android, and for using it without any internet.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, in any browser. On iPhone and iPad, open it in Safari: results of any size download to Files → Downloads. It updates itself with each release.

## The online version

- **Opens quickly on a slow connection.** Once you've used it, a saved copy opens after a few seconds if the network is slow, instead of waiting for it.
- **Works offline** once opened, and can be installed: Share → Add to Home Screen, or the install button in Chrome and Edge.
- **From the Home Screen on iPhone and iPad**, a result too big for the share sheet says to open the page in Safari itself if its download doesn't start, since iOS may not start downloads there.
- **A copy put on another site** without the online version's files keeps working, without trying to link files it doesn't have.

## Also

- **Help** explains both ways to run Discpress, and that results not saved yet stay listed under *From your last visit*.

The CHDs are the same as 1.3.0's.
